headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned Hamas that if an Israeli soldier or civilian is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. Speaking at a memorial ceremony, Gallant emphasized that Israel will not retreat from its red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the strip is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating that Iran's Supreme Leader was eliminated and the threat of nuclear annihilation removed.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"

headlines.snippet: Netanel Kron, who was murdered in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest in the cemetery in Ali Zahav. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, bid farewell, saying, "Thank you for giving me life." His wife, Merav, described him as the most involved father in the world, and his sister, Ruti, called him a pleasant, wise, and humble person.
